notes.title: A big one!
notes.content: [h1]Patch to v1.19[/h1][p] [/p][h3]Engine Upgrade: [/h3][p]The entire project has been migrated from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5. This transition lays the foundation for future development and brings updated graphics and performance standards.   [/p][p] [/p][h3]Performance Improvements:[/h3][p]Overall performance has been optimized, including more stable frame rates, faster loading times, and smoother gameplay – especially on mid-range systems.[/p][p]      [/p][h3]New Sound Effects:[/h3][p]A range of new sound effects has been implemented to enhance the overall audio experience. Existing sounds have been adjusted for better balance and clarity.   [/p][p][/p][h3]Level Design Improvements:[/h3][p]Several levels have been reworked visually and structurally. The changes aim to improve game flow and enrich the overall atmosphere.   [/p][p][/p][h3]Savegames:[/h3][p]A new save system has been implemented. Multiple save slots can now be used.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Lighting & Atmosphere:[/h3][p]Lighting conditions have been refined in various scenes to enhance visibility and strengthen the mood.   [/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][p]A number of minor and major bugs have been resolved, affecting gameplay, UI behavior, and collisions.  [/p]

notes.title: Gamepad support - even the last bugs have to go...
notes.content:
[h1]Patch to v1.12:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Optimized operation in the options menu with mouse and keyboard
[*] Spontaneous switching from mouse and keyboard to controller is now possible in the main menu
[*] Incorrect focusing of buttons when using mouse and keyboard in the options menu fixed
[*] Controller images added to the control explanation in the options menu (when the controller is in use)
[*] Incorrect focusing in two other submenus when using mouse and keyboard fixed
[*] Explanations of the masks in the mask menu (when starting an action level) are now written in more detail and made more eye-catching
[*] When trying to pick up a weapon while wearing a bear mask, the bear symbol in the bottom right corner wobbles and an “error” sound is played. This is for a better understanding of the bear mask
[*] Fixed an incorrect sound (click sound) in the mask menu when using the mouse and keyboard
[*] Some graphics of the fonts in menus adjusted when hovering with the mouse
[/list]
